title: Taipei Morning Brief research pack

cutoff.research_window: Overnight developments available by the cutoff; completed 2026-09-23 US session for USD, US Treasuries and gold, and a synchronized rolling 24-hour crypto window ending at the cutoff.
cutoff.future_data_guard: No observation after 2026-09-24 09:45 Taipei is used. Sources fetched after the cutoff were used only to verify already completed bars, dated ETF rows, and pre-cutoff reporting. The 2026-09-24 Trump-Xi summit is an upcoming catalyst, not a completed event; no outcome is assumed.

topline: The overnight impulse was a rates-and-oil shock: strong US flash PMIs, a hawkish Fed message and a weak 5-year Treasury auction pushed the official 10-year par yield from 4.96% to 5.11%, while the dollar strengthened.

Gold, BTC and ETH all printed bearish candles despite geopolitical tension; ETH underperformed BTC slightly. This is consistent with a higher-real-yield/liquidity headwind dominating safe-haven demand at the cutoff.

US spot-crypto ETF flows were strongly positive through the latest complete Farside date, 2026-09-22, but that lagged evidence did not prevent the subsequent 24-hour BTC/ETH decline. Do not treat the incomplete 2026-09-23 Farside row as a final daily flow.

For Taiwan, the immediate setup is a valuation and foreign-flow headwind for duration-heavy electronics, partially offset by a stronger-dollar translation cushion for exporters. Oil above USD100 adds margin risk for energy-intensive and transport sectors.

material_news.headline: Hot US flash PMIs and Barr's hawkish message repriced the rate path

source_time.note: The official S&P Global and Federal Reserve pages expose the date but not a normalized publication time in the checked text.

verified_facts: S&P Global's flash US Composite PMI rose to 58.4 from 56.0, the highest since July 2021; services activity was 58.7 and manufacturing PMI was 57.0.
S&P Global said input costs rose at the steepest pace in four years, with fuel and transport costs contributing.

Fed Governor Michael Barr said growth was strong, the labor market solid, inflation above 2% and not clearly returning to target in a timely way; in his base case, further policy adjustments were likely needed.
Reuters reported the 2-year yield up 11.4 bp to 4.891% and the 10-year yield up 13.89 bp to 5.106%; fed-funds futures assigned a 66% probability to an October hike, up from 53% earlier that day.
material_news.evidence_class: Official/original for PMI and Barr; Reuters attributed for market reaction.
material_news.taiwan_mapping_inference: Negative immediate valuation impulse for long-duration Taiwan electronics and AI supply-chain equities; a stronger USD can cushion TWD-reported exporter revenue, but no USD/TWD move was verified in this pack.
material_news.uncertainty: PMI is a flash survey, not hard activity data. The 66% hike probability was a Reuters snapshot, not a policy commitment.

material_news.headline: Weak Treasury auction reinforced the long-end selloff
verified_facts: Reuters reported weak demand at the USD70bn 5-year note auction and the highest auction yield since 2007.
The US Treasury's official daily curve shows 2Y 4.85%, 5Y 4.99%, 10Y 5.11% and 30Y 5.40% for 2026-09-23, versus 4.71%, 4.83%, 4.96% and 5.29% on 2026-09-22.
material_news.evidence_class: Official/original for the daily curve; Reuters attributed for auction characterization.
material_news.taiwan_mapping_inference: The 10Y/30Y rise raises the global discount rate and can pressure high-multiple growth stocks even if earnings expectations are unchanged. Taiwan financials may receive a mixed signal: higher yields can help reinvestment income but worsen mark-to-market and global risk appetite.
material_news.uncertainty: A single auction does not establish a durable term-premium trend; subsequent inflation, supply and policy evidence is required.

material_news.headline: Iran-US tensions lifted oil above USD100 and compounded inflation risk
verified_facts: Reuters reported that Iran's president told the UN General Assembly that Tehran would not bow to US pressure while diplomacy should continue; this is wire attribution, not direct transcript verification in this pack.
The Reuters market wrap reported US crude at USD92.60, up 2.3%, and Brent at USD103.50, up 4.28%.
The same report recorded spot gold down 1.64% to USD4,283.40, showing that higher yields and USD strength outweighed the geopolitical bid during the session.
material_news.evidence_class: Reuters attributed via checked Euronext syndication.
material_news.taiwan_mapping_inference: Higher crude is negative for airlines, transport and energy-intensive manufacturers; refiners and petrochemicals depend on crack spreads and pass-through rather than crude direction alone. Persistent oil pressure would also reduce the odds of near-term global easing.
material_news.uncertainty: War and diplomacy headlines can reverse quickly. No ceasefire, blockade or shipping-policy change is inferred beyond the checked report.

material_news.headline: Wall Street closed lower; technology and communication services led the risk-off move
verified_facts: Reuters' closing report said Alphabet fell 3.8%, Amazon 2.2%, the PHLX semiconductor index 1.2% and Nvidia 1.5%.
material_news.evidence_class: Reuters attributed via checked Euronext/MarketScreener syndication.
material_news.taiwan_mapping_inference: Negative opening sentiment for semiconductors and AI hardware, but the move is macro-led; it is not evidence of a Taiwan supply-chain order cut.
material_news.uncertainty: US sector performance is a sentiment input, not a one-for-one forecast for TWSE returns.

cross_asset_kline_first.method: Use completed US-session daily candles for DXY, CBOE 10Y yield and COMEX Gold Dec-2026. Use 96 completed Coinbase 15-minute bars from 2026-09-23 09:45 Taipei through the bar ending 2026-09-24 09:45 Taipei for BTC and ETH. Exclude bars starting at the cutoff. Percent change is close/open minus one.

eth_btc.method: Derived from synchronized Coinbase ETH-USD divided by BTC-USD at the same window endpoints; this avoids implying synchronization from separate latest ticks.
eth_btc.interpretation: ETH underperformed BTC modestly. This is a relative-risk signal, not a standalone trend break; the move is small compared with the direct ETH-BTC pair's 24-hour range.
eth_btc.cross_check: Coinbase's direct ETH-BTC market closed at 0.031835. It returned 82 non-empty 15-minute bars in the window, so the synchronized USD-derived ratio is used for the displayed change.

crypto_us_spot_farside.incomplete_row_policy: The current BTC table exposed a 2026-09-23 row with most major fund cells marked '-' and only MSBT +32.4, while an all-data snapshot showed a conflicting/incomplete zero row. The 2026-09-23 row is therefore excluded from final daily-flow evidence. No complete 2026-09-23 ETH row was verified by the cutoff.
crypto_us_spot_farside.interpretation: Strong completed inflows through 2026-09-22 were supportive medium-term demand evidence, but they are dated and cannot be used to explain away the subsequent bearish 24-hour price candles.
crypto_us_spot_farside.source_quality: Farside primary flow aggregator; direct origin returned HTTP 403, so canonical-page extractions from multiple search backends were reconciled. Only complete dated rows with constituent totals were retained.

gold_global_wgc.interpretation: August showed strong structural ETF demand and record holdings, but this is monthly evidence dated 31 August, not proof of buying during the 23 September gold selloff.
gold_global_wgc.source_quality: World Gold Council original report. The current data page states weekly and monthly updates; the latest downloadable monthly dataset checked was August 2026.

taiwan_implications.signal: Negative for high-duration electronics and AI/semiconductor multiples because US 10Y closed around 5.11% and Nasdaq fell 1.13%.
taiwan_implications.offset: A stronger USD may help exporter translation if TWD weakens, but USD/TWD was not collected and no FX benefit should be assumed.

taiwan_implications.signal: Oil above USD100 raises costs for airlines, shipping fuel users, plastics, chemicals and other energy-intensive manufacturers; pass-through ability is the key differentiator.
taiwan_implications.offset: Refiners may benefit only if product crack spreads improve; crude direction alone is insufficient.

taiwan_implications.signal: The scheduled 2026-09-24 Trump-Xi Washington summit can create trade, technology-control and AI-chain headline volatility.
taiwan_implications.offset: Reuters described possible trade-truce extension discussion but low mutual trust on AI; no agreement or policy change had occurred by the cutoff.
taiwan_implications.confidence: High that the event is scheduled; low on outcome

taiwan_implications.signal: BTC -2.48%, ETH -2.69% and ETH/BTC -0.21% indicate softer speculative risk appetite.
taiwan_implications.offset: Completed US spot-ETF flows were positive through 22 September, so the crypto signal is risk-off at the margin rather than evidence of a structural demand collapse.

ranked_risks_to_watch: 1. US long-end yields: confirmation above the 5.10%-5.14% area versus a reversal after the weak auction.
2. Oil and Iran diplomacy: persistence of Brent above USD100 and any verified shipping/Strait policy change.
3. Trump-Xi summit: only signed measures or official statements count; do not trade rumors as completed policy.
4. Crypto follow-through: BTC response around the USD83.5k window low and whether ETH/BTC continues to weaken.
5. ETF data completion: wait for a fully populated 2026-09-23 Farside row before citing that day's net flow.

calculation_rules: Price return = close/open - 1; basis-point yield moves use percentage-point differences multiplied by 100.
BTC and ETH use the same 96 completed Coinbase 15-minute intervals. ETH/BTC is derived from synchronized USD legs.
Farside daily totals were recomputed from available fund columns; incomplete or conflicting rows were excluded.
Source date, market trade date and data-period end are kept separate.
known_limitations: DXY and futures OHLC use Yahoo Finance, a secondary distributor; the US Treasury official feed anchors the principal rates close.
Gold futures and spot gold are different instruments. The Kline table uses COMEX Dec-2026 futures and separately cites Reuters spot gold.
Direct Farside origin access returned HTTP 403; canonical-page search extractions were reconciled instead of treating a partial table as final.
No direct social/X posts were used or inferred. Trump and Iranian remarks are included only as Reuters-attributed public-speech reporting.
